purpose: Provide a clearly separated estimated central-bank pricing layer for currencies whose official OIS/futures runtime remains WITHHELD. This layer must never masquerade as official OIS data.
source_precedence: existing secondary instrument quote already stored in NATIVE_CB_DATA.market_pricing
existing partial-official central-bank market-pricing point already stored in NATIVE_CB_DATA.market_pricing

USD.basis: CBOT Fed Funds futures secondary quote layer; instrument identity validated, official current/T-1 evidence exists, full official weekly history not yet certified.

EUR.basis: Eurex Three-Month Euro STR futures secondary quote layer; instrument and quote convention validated, historical official settlements not yet reproducible.

CHF.basis: ICE Three-Month SARON futures secondary quote layer; instrument and convention validated, free official daily settlement history not reproducible.

NZD.basis: Partial official RBNZ market-pricing point; only the surfaced near-term point is retained, with no invented 6M/12M path.

output_rules.policy_delta_bp: 100 * (estimated market rate - current policy rate) when both are available
output_rules.two_year_change_1w_proxy_bp: Optional front-end context copied from NATIVE_RATES_DATA.chg2_bp. This is not an OIS change and must never be labelled as such.
output_rules.missing_horizons: Remain null; no interpolation or curve invention is permitted.

governance.promotion_rule: An estimated currency can move to the official OIS layer only after the original homogeneous-source activation condition is satisfied.
